title: Choose the Pit Board layout
question: Three compositions in Broadcast Booth Glass. Same job: glance last lap and delta at race speed, with name and place as support. Custom PNG art still skins whichever layout you lock. A depth-dive structure sits in the re-roll pool.

options.label: Vertical Staff
options.thesis: Last lap sits on the baseline; delta rises above it like a split on a vertical staff.
options.viewport: Tall plaque. Dim You / HOLESHOT at the top. Huge 01:35.000 on the baseline. Green -0.347 stacked above. Orange P2 bug on the staff.
options.risk: Can read as Sectors stood on end; slower than a board held at chest height.

raised.raise: Each shown stat is its own cell; hiding one leaves no empty dashes.
Pending times stay as ghost digits, never blank holes.

options.label: Hero Stack
options.thesis: A glass pit board: identity, then place, then huge last and signed delta.
options.viewport: Rounded plate, two holes. HOLESHOT / You on top. P2 · session · laps mid. 01:35.000 then -0.347 as the heroes.
options.risk: This is the familiar MX pit-board reading — most runs in this category land here.

options.label: Hair Delta
options.thesis: The board is a Delta Bar with a last-lap caption — Hair family, not a plate.
options.viewport: Wide lockup. Huge -0.347. Last 01:35.000 as supporting type. You and P2 as dim end caps. Green left of zero, red right.
options.risk: Two delta widgets on screen if Delta Bar is also on.

options.label: Stamp Grid
options.thesis: Every ticked stat is a postage-stamp cell in a tight grid.
options.viewport: 2×3 cells: You, P2, 01:35.000, -0.347, L4, session. Last and delta slightly larger, still cells.
options.risk: Equal cells fight the glance; last and delta stop being heroes.

options.label: Digit Mask
options.thesis: Last lap is a rigid digit mask; unlit slots stay as ghosts.
options.viewport: 01:35.000 in fixed slots, dim ghosts in unused cells. Signed -0.347 in a cell beside. You and P2 as captions.
options.case: Beats the staff on glance and MX identification: a pit board is times.
options.risk: Can look like a clock if the identity captions vanish.

options.label: Band Signs
options.thesis: One fact per band. Last is the monumental gate number.
options.viewport: Three stacked bands. Huge 01:35.000. Delta band. P2 as the orange bug. You as a dim caption.
options.case: Holds clarity: one message per line, like a junction sign.
options.risk: Three bands can read as a settings list, not a crew board.

options.label: Elbow Pills
options.thesis: Thick elbows frame ranked pills; each pill is one stat.
options.viewport: A sweeping elbow around last and delta pills, P2 as the gold-active segment.
options.case: Loses both axes: riders do not identify with a console wall.
options.kept: Each shown stat is a discrete cell; unused stats vanish.

options.label: Fold Sequence
options.thesis: The board unfolds from a square into last, then delta, then identity.
options.viewport: A square collapsing into the hero stack through numbered folds.
options.case: Loses both axes: a teaching sequence is not a race glance.
options.kept: Remaining heroes reflow when a stat hides.

options.label: Glyph Field
options.thesis: Density of glyphs stands in for the board; last lap is the densest cluster.
options.viewport: A character grid where 01:35.000 is the highlight cluster.
options.case: Loses both axes: glyph sculpture is not glanceable on track.
options.kept: Pending times are drawn as ghosts, never omitted.

canonCard.label: White number plate
canonCard.thesis: What sim HUDs ship: a white MX plate, black number, last and delta as stickers.
canonCard.viewport: White rounded plate, huge #77, name under it, last and delta as small stickers.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from a generic sim overlay by design.
